goal: Implement scheduled snapshot and atomic restore for SINGLE and DOUBLE stores so cold-start restores from a CRC-validated snapshot plus guaranteed journal cursor reconciliation.
requirements: Store.snapshot(Path) writes a snapshot with magic/version header and per-page CRC.
Store.restore(Path) atomically swaps in the snapshot after full validation.
Restore reconciles with the guaranteed journal cursor.
Restore must not surface staged-but-unjournaled writes until the journal cursor is reconciled.
SINGLE and DOUBLE direct/mmap stores must support snapshot and restore.
constraints: Zero allocation on the publish hot path stays invariant.
qa/smoke.sh must pass the allocation gate.
Restore latency must be below 10ms p99 for a 1M-key snapshot.
acceptance_criteria: Round-trip integration test writes keys, snapshots, kills JVM, restores, and reads all keys.
Crash-mid-journal test shows only journal-acknowledged writes after restore.
CRC mismatch aborts restore with a structured invariant failure and no state mutation.
Stale or invalid snapshot headers are rejected.
Partial snapshot writes are rejected without mutating live state.
